scope: Owned finite memory entries to a single completed ZIP32 Vec<u8>. Backend implementation candidate only. No file input, traversal, extraction, publication, worker, IPC or UI.

api.function: create<C>(Request, C) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Failure> where C: FnMut(Checkpoint) -> Result<(), Stop>
api.request: Request { entries: Vec<Entry>, options: Options, limits: Limits, timeout: Duration }
api.options: Options { method: Method::Stored|Deflate, encrypted: bool, split: bool, zip64: bool }; Default: Deflate, unsupported flags false
api.limits: Limits { input: u64, output: u64, entries: usize, processed: u64 }; each effective limit is min(caller, hard maximum). entries includes artifact.
api.checkpoint: Start, Validate{index}, Entry{index}, Input{index,offset,len}, Write{offset,len,extent}, Seek{from,to}, Flush, Finish, Return. Offsets and extent describe the operation before mutation. No byte content exposed.
api.ownership: Request ownership transfers at call. Entry bytes are read without modification, then dropped normally. No input recovery API on failure; do not claim moved inputs are returned or zeroized.

limits.processedAccounting: Reserve full known input total before creating the writer. Every output write checks input total + max(previous extent, write end), including central directory and patch writes. Rewrites do not charge duplicate bytes. Never infer a pass just from final output length.
limits.allocation: Check length and budgets before try_reserve_exact/resize. Private output Vec only. Input already allocated by caller; no total heap cap. Allocator may reserve more capacity than requested. ZIP metadata and compressor allocation/OOM/panic are not fully recoverable.

format.methods: Stored or Deflate level 6; default Deflate
format.zip64: Rejected option; large_file(false), default auto_large_file=false, at most 16 MiB and 1024 entries
format.permissions: Fixed regular file mode 0644; no filesystem metadata is restored.
format.entries: Input order retained; only file entries, empty files allowed; no empty archive or explicit directory entries.
format.extra: No comment or custom extra fields supplied; library owns all ZIP encoding and CRC.

names.policy: Portable ASCII subset, independent of host OS. No Unicode normalization or OrdinalIgnoreCase emulation.
names.reject: Empty/non-ASCII name; >1024 bytes; empty, dot or parent components; components >255 bytes; leading/trailing slash; backslash; ASCII controls including DEL; <>:"|?*; trailing space/dot; all-space component; Windows reserved CON PRN AUX NUL CONIN$ CONOUT$ COM1..9 LPT1..9 stems (case-insensitive, trim spaces before extension).
names.conflicts: ASCII-case-insensitive duplicates and file/child conflicts in either order. Intermediate directory case spelling is not canonicalized.
names.compatibility: Stricter than C# Linux names and Windows backslash normalization. Unicode/Korean and OS parity remain unsupported. DOS timestamp differs from C# generation time. ZIP byte-for-byte equality is not a parity criterion.

lifecycle.gate: First observed gate failure is sticky. Failed checks, storage limit/allocation/seek errors block later writes, seeks, flushes and callbacks. Preparation errors are latched before explicitly dropping ZipWriter.
lifecycle.finish: ZipWriter::finish consumes writer; it can internally Drop/finalize again on error. Returned original ZipError is mapped before considering later cleanup effects, so cleanup does not replace the original returned cause. Storage failures carry typed Failure inside io::Error.
lifecycle.dropLimit: Cannot suppress upstream Drop stderr diagnostics or all backend-internal retry work. On backend-only finish error, implicit Drop occurs before the error becomes visible to caller; do not claim all internal cleanup writes are preblocked in that case. No artifact escapes on any returned error.
lifecycle.success: Only successful finish followed by final Return cancellation/deadline checkpoint permits Vec extraction. No partial artifact is public.
lifecycle.deadline: Monotonic Instant checked before and after caller callback. Deadline/cancellation are cooperative between calls. Callback and codec calls cannot be preempted; panic/OOM/CPU hard limits and live supervision are not implemented.

dependencies.license: zip MIT; existing flate2 MIT OR Apache-2.0; zlib-rs Zlib with rust-allocator only. Cargo metadata licenses checked; no new dependency or vulnerability-free claim.

sourceEvidence.crate: Cached zip 9.5.0 src/write.rs new, finish, Drop and src/write/options.rs. No copied codec/crypto or ZIP serializer.
